title: Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Make Your Phone Hot. Here’s How to Keep It Cool
summary: If you do stick with wireless Android Auto or CarPlay, try to avoid charging your phone at the same time, especially on the wireless pad built into the car’s dash (which generates more heat).
